headline: 阿里新片談信仰與殺手
context: 馬赫夏拉．阿里（Mahershala Ali）主演新片《Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother》，飾演一名虔誠穆斯林教徒，同時也是自認在替天行道的契約殺手。導演巴薩姆．塔里克（Bassam Tariq）原本要接拍《刀鋒戰士》（Blade）重啟版，計畫停擺後才轉向拍出這部片，故事背景設在休士頓。

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: “Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother” was conceived well before the star and the director met for “Blade.” But it was fatherhood that informed the new movie.
sources.title: Mahershala Ali and Bassam Tariq on Faith and Love in ‘Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother’

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: In the film-maker’s Houston-set film, Ali stars as a devout Muslim who moonlights as a vicious hitman Mahershala Ali is swinging around a blade in Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother . That’s not a nod to Ali’s previous attachment to Marvel’s Blade. It’s of a piece with Ali’s character, Latif, a devout Muslim who also happens to be a contract killer, though he fashions himself a righteous killer. Latif justifies his violence as divine retribution, dispensing victims he believes to have offended God. His sword, according to writer and director Bassam Tariq, is a part of Latif’s code, a negotiation with his faith. “You are forced to strike with intention when you use a sword,” Tariq says, speaking in a recent interview in Toronto. Continue reading...
sources.title: How Bassam Tariq pivoted from stalled Blade reboot to new Mahershala Ali thriller: ‘I’m happier I made this movie’
